message: The other day, I was chatting with my neighbor about smoke alarms, and I couldn't help but feel a bit smug when I mentioned how I finally replaced the batteries in mine. Just last week, I had a mini panic when I realized they were long overdue. Turns out, my little reminder was a lifesaver after all! It’s funny how we sometimes brush off these things until it’s too late. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately? What’s your best tip for staying safe in the kitchen?
